verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a Data Access API (published as an OpenAPI spec) for reading errors and projects, plus an official SmartBear MCP server with OAuth login, so an agent can pull error data. It also separately documents creating and syncing issues in Jira or other trackers. The evidence does not show stack traces returned through the API/MCP, ranking of top issues, or an agent-driven path for triaging or filing tracker issues. Missing for 10: stack-trace retrieval via API/MCP, documented MCP tool list for triage and status changes, an agent- or API-triggered tracker filing flow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my top production issues with stack traces via API or MCP, triage them, and file the real bugs into my tracker

citations.quote: Allows you to access information about your BugSnag errors, projects, organization and more to build custom integrations using your data.
Self Hosted MCP Server OAuth 2.0 support — securely connect to BugSnag via browser-based login instead of manual API tokens.
Create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker.
